description: Deprecated alias of get_provider. Get a published provider or media profile by exact slug, including sourced facts and evidence statuses, approved answers and overview, sources, assessment and missing information. Supplier-stated means the organisation says so, not independent verification. Missing means unknown; egg_score measures evidence readiness, not product quality.

slug.description: Exact provider or media profile slug returned by search_providers or search; copy it rather than guessing. Use the lowercase hyphenated identifier (1-120 characters), not a title or full URL.
